Handcrafted British stainless steel. Exceptional value.
The Enigma Extensor is a UK-handcrafted stainless steel road frame, built in our Sussex workshop using premium Columbus XCR tubing. Combining responsive handling, refined ride quality and outstanding corrosion resistance, it offers the performance of a modern road frame with the timeless appeal of stainless steel.
Designed for performance road riding and longer days in the saddle, the Extensor features a satin bead finish with contrasting brushed logos, showcasing the distinctive character of Columbus XCR stainless steel.
